Quick update on the prefix caching check: the experiment that increased cache hit rate will shift the median inference path by ~15ms; the 95th pctl has a smaller change (~6–8ms) because of GPU scheduling variance. That means Markus' draft numbers will need a small adjustment but no structural change.

Important constraint for the exec note: if we pre-warm Dedicated pool capacity we have a ~2 hour lead time to spin up extra nodes (provisioning + image boot). Pre-warm is fine, but for real-time surge we need the tiered fallback Markus suggested. If the exec wants a guaranteed <100ms 95th pctl during a Black Friday event, we need a larger reserved buffer or SLA exception.

No attachments.
